description:
Her twelfth life arrived after passing through eleven regressions. What awaited her every time she turned back the clock was her husband’s unilateral demand for a divorce. 

Max Russell. The grandson of a great revolutionary hero, the son of a notorious con artist, and a successful young businessman who overcame his shameful past. 

Freya Russell. The only daughter of a Duke, who voluntarily gave up her high-born life because she was madly in love with that very husband. In every past life, whenever Max declared he wanted a divorce, Freya would cling to him like a madwoman. But this time, she lays down her obsession and accepts Max’s “sincerity” for the first time. 

“Fine. Let’s get a divorce.” 

Facing Max, who is visibly shaken by her unexpected answer, Freya sets just one condition.
